name: Confession Deep-Sixed
source:
A girl talking to her departed ones in the cemetery with a shovel.
A web-based novel without audio or main menu.
A short kinetic novel made for O2A2 (Only One of Any Asset), a visual novel jam.

[From [url=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/confession-deep-sixed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩在墓地里拿着铲子与她已故的人交谈。
没有音频或主菜单的网络小说。
为O2A2（任何资产中的唯一一个）制作的一部简短的动态小说，视觉小说即兴创作。

[来自[url=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/confession-deep-sixed]Itch.io[/url]]
